description: Bachmann et al., NIM A 438 (1999) 376: standard single GEM in Ar:CO2 70:30 at 1 atm, effective gain from the signal current (no pulser)
notes: Standard GEM: pitch 140 um (hex), metal holes 70 um, kapton holes 55 um at the centre (Bachmann Fig. 6: D = 70, d = 55), 50 um kapton, 5 um Cu.
Effective gain M = I_S / (e n R) from the PCB current, n ~ 220 for 6 keV X-rays; 'real gain' from all electrode currents.
Benchmarks read off the figures: Fig. 13 (dV = 500 V, E_D = 1, E_I = 3 kV/cm): effective ~350, real ~900; Fig. 24 GEM1 (E_D = 3, E_I = 4.4 kV/cm): ~75 at 400 V, ~210 at 450 V.
Penning: Garfield's Ar:CO2 parameterisation at 1 atm (Sahin et al. NIM A 768 (2014) 104), r = 0.57 for 30% CO2.
